module: MCP file system tools: read/write text files, list, search, delete, copy, rename, create folders. Read/write go through io.open (relative to the game's current folder: loose files on disk only); listing and search go through BeamNG's VFS (also see the contents of zips).
notes: Security warning: these tools allow reading, writing and deleting files with no path restriction on the Lua side (the only limit is io.open's sandbox; delete/copy/rename/make_dir go through FS:).
read_file/write_file strip leading '/' from the path (VFS path -> relative disk path); read_file truncates at maxBytes (default 100000).
find_files returns at most 1000 entries (count gives the total); depth -1 = fully recursive.
delete_file, copy_file, rename_file, make_dir treat return code 0 as success and return "failed" in the text without setting isError to true.

read_file.desc: Reads a text file (jbeam, json, lua…) and returns it, truncated at maxBytes.

write_file.desc: Writes (overwrites) a text file, creating the parent folders (FS:directoryCreate).

list_dir.desc: Lists a folder (VFS) as JSON via FS:directoryList.

args.desc: {path?: string (default '/'), files?: boolean, dirs?: boolean}; if neither files nor dirs, both are included.

find_files.desc: Searches for files by glob pattern (FS:findFiles).

args.desc: {path?: string (default '/'), pattern?: string (default '*'), depth?: integer (default 1, -1 = all)}

returns.desc: true only if path is missing.
